title: Unbolt Escape Jam
description: Twist free trapped latches, iron bars, and color-coded bolts to spring open every locked contraption and break out cleanly.
controls: Tap bolts and empty sockets strategically to detach every locking bar blocking your escape.

zh-CN.title: 关不住我拆锁
zh-CN.description: 魔性拆螺丝闯关关不住我：拧松层层铁锁与机关螺栓，破解严密机关顺利脱身，节奏紧凑越玩越爽！
zh-CN.controls: 点击拆移关键螺栓到空孔，卸掉所有挡路铁片机关即可成功脱困。
